document_metadata.title: NIOS CORE v3.0: Sovereign Autonomous Quantitative Operating System — Principal Systems Architecture Specification
document_metadata.summary: NIOS Core v3.0 is a principal systems architecture specification (document NIOS-ARC-2026-V3, version 3.0.0-PROD, 14 pages) for an operating-system-isolated autonomous quantitative trading platform built on four air-gapped process rings. It specifies a 0.14 ms p99 Rust/Cython spinal reflex scalper, a bicameral LLM brain combining MiroFish five-archetype contagion simulation with a TradingAgents investment committee, a 98% split-conformal capital deployment gate, and a TigerBeetle/PostgreSQL 16 double-entry IBOR protected by SHA-256 numerical grounding. The document also defines latency benchmarks, TLA+/VOPR formal safety proofs, four broker-market silos, operator APIs, a four-phase roadmap, and five constitutional laws.

content_blocks.text: Executive Positioning: NIOS Core v3.0 replaces monolithic large language model (LLM) trading scripts with an operating-system-isolated, mathematically gated capital engine that abstains on 99.1% of market noise. By separating sub-millisecond compiled orderflow execution (Ring 1) from asynchronous cognitive reasoning (Ring 2) and air-gapped cryptographic key custody (Ring 0), the platform eliminates tick-latency bleed, orderbook spoofing traps, numerical hallucination, and prompt-injection key exfiltration across four global market silos.

sections.heading: 01. Executive Technical Overview: Solving the 7 Fatal Flaws of Naive AI Trading
sections.summary: Enumerates the seven structural failure modes of monolithic LLM trading agents and pairs each with the NIOS Core v3.0 architectural countermeasure.

content_blocks.text: First-generation autonomous financial agents fail in live production because they place high-latency generative models directly inside the market tick loop, trust spoofable limit-order books, and expose broker API credentials inside processes that scrape untrusted external web content. NIOS Core v3.0 engineers out all seven structural failure modes through three non-negotiable architectural pillars.

table_data.root_cause_in_monolithic_architectures: Calling a 300 ms LLM on live WebSocket ticks guarantees adverse selection against 0.1 ms high-frequency market makers.
table_data.nios_core_v3_ground_up_breakthrough: 3-Speed Bicameral Brain: 0.14 ms compiled math Spinal Reflex armed asynchronously by <80 ms System 1 leases and governed by System 2 deep contagion.

table_data.root_cause_in_monolithic_architectures: Triggering entries on resting L2 bid/ask depth falls prey to 40 ms phantom liquidity pulls and layering algorithms.
table_data.nios_core_v3_ground_up_breakthrough: Executed Flow Physics (OFI): Ignores resting limit orders; triggers strictly on aggressive Taker Buy/Sell ratios (≥ 65%) and Cancel-to-Fill velocity (< 3.0).

table_data.root_cause_in_monolithic_architectures: Static Bull/Bear LLM prompts miss 2nd- and 3rd-order forced liquidations (Vol-CTAs, Dealer Gamma flips, Pod Shop stops).
table_data.nios_core_v3_ground_up_breakthrough: MiroFish 5-Archetype Cascade: Simulates Retail 0DTE, Options Dealers, Vol-CTAs, Pod Shops, and Value Funds across 3 deterministic ticks.

table_data.nios_core_v3_ground_up_breakthrough: 4-Ring Process Air-Gap: Untrusted ingestion (Ring 2) is physically isolated from the Broker Signer Vault (Ring 0) and Zero-GC Spinal Loop (Ring 1).

sections.heading: The Three Foundational Design Pillars
sections.summary: Defines the three governing principles: point-in-time cryptographic truth, the 98% split-conformal precision gate with tail-copula shield, and nightly Darwinian strategy evolution.

content_blocks.text: Pillar 1 — Cryptographic Truth & Point-in-Time (PIT) Integrity (Ring 2 Truth): Every market bar, SEC 10-K/10-Q filing, and factor output is stamped with both validTime and knowledgeTimestamp (filing acceptance cutoff). A Self-Healing Dual-Vendor Router quarantines any tick with >1.50% cross-vendor divergence or unadjusted split gaps, while the SHA-256 Grounding Ledger hashes every numeric figure prior to LLM ingestion.

Pillar 2 — 98% Split-Conformal Precision Gate & Tail-Copula Shield (Ring 0 Vault): Capital deploys only when worst-case lower-bound net edge is strictly positive: Net_LB = E[r] − (Spread + 2 × Fee + Tax + Q_0.98(Residuals)) > 0. A Cross-Silo Copula Shield dynamically shrinks position sizing whenever tail correlation across Crypto, US, and India silos exceeds 0.60.

Pillar 3 — Darwinian Self-Evolution (Nocturnal Alpha Forge): No strategy or agent holds a permanent seat. Every night at 00:00 UTC, the Nocturnal Alpha Forge audits the active roster, automatically demoting any live champion whose rolling net edge drops below +0.50 bps and promoting walk-forward challengers achieving a Deflated Sharpe Ratio ≥ 1.50 across 30+ winning shadow fills.

Semantic purpose: shows data-lineage owners exactly where a feed can be rejected, normalized, or cryptographically committed before reaching any trading logic.

items: 1. Anti-Spoofing Orderflow Serialization (Ring 1 Ingest): Instead of passing manipulable L2 resting limit-order book snapshots to the scalper, the normalizer aggregates 5-second rolling ExecutedFlowTick frames measuring takerBuyVolume5s vs. takerSellVolume5s (who actually crossed the spread and paid fees) alongside bidCancelToFillRatio and askCancelToFillRatio (flagging phantom liquidity pulls whenever ratio ≥ 3.0).

2. SEC & Fundamental Knowledge-Time Guard (Anti-Lookahead): Harvested from TradingAgents/vendors/sec-edgar.py, financial statements are indexed strictly by SEC EDGAR acceptance timestamp rather than fiscal period end. This prevents walk-forward learners from reading Q4 earnings in January when the 10-K was actually filed in March, raising a hard exception if t_knowledge > t_as-of.

3. Numerical Grounding Gate (Zero Hallucination): Harvested from Vibe-Trading/agent/grounding/ledger.py, every computed factor, price, and DCF output is registered in an immutable lookup map. Before any System 2 committee synthesis reaches Ring 0, an AST/regex verifier checks every cited figure against GroundedFactPacket; any fabricated number triggers UNGROUNDED-NUMERICAL-CLAIM and aborts order signing.

Semantic purpose: establishes the durability and consistency contract for each class of platform state so recovery and audit tooling can be designed against known guarantees.

Investment Book of Record (IBOR — TigerBeetle + PostgreSQL 16): NIOS maintains an internal double-entry general ledger independent of broker UI snapshots, tracking every cent in 128-bit integers across four vaults per broker silo: ReserveYield, LongTermCompounder, TacticalSwing, and SpinalScalper. Point-in-time NAV is computed using historical FX rates and deducts accrued STT, TDS, stamp duty, and maker/taker fees on every fill.

Two-Phase Crash-Atomic Outbox & 60s Reconciliation: Before any signed order touches a broker socket, Ring 0 commits a TigerBeetle two-phase pending transfer and a PostgreSQL 16 financialOutbox record with a deterministic idempotency key. If power or network drops mid-flight, NautilusTrader live reconciliation queries open broker orders on restart, settles or voids pending transfers atomically, and freezes any silo exhibiting >0.01% position drift.

Delayed Settlement & Darwinian Episodic Memory: Every agent prediction is logged with an explicit evaluation horizon. Once the holding period elapses, the settlement worker grades predicted basis points against realized net basis points, updates the agent's 200-trade rolling conformal residual window (Q_0.98), and adjusts its Darwinian trust multiplier between 0.8× and 1.5×.

sections.heading: 08. Security, Governance, Formal Verification & Circuit Breakers
sections.summary: Establishes the zero-trust prompt-injection defence via OS air-gaps and hardware signing, and defines the three-tier circuit breaker hierarchy.

content_blocks.text: Any LLM that ingests live financial news, RSS feeds, or social sentiment is exposed to indirect prompt injection. NIOS Core v3.0 makes credential theft and rogue order submission impossible by construction: safety is enforced by OS kernel process boundaries, hardware-backed cryptographic signing, and model-checked state machines—never by hoping an LLM follows instructions in a system prompt.
